title: The Gravity of Sector Nine Anew
author: Zephyrine Okafor
blurb: Freya Eastwick, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
